definitions.explanation: Large-scale stage equipment and scenery used in theater, film, or television productions. Includes backdrops, set pieces, and structural elements. Contrasts with 小道具 (small props, hand props).

examples.japanese: {大道具|おおどうぐ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Preparations for the stage set are underway.

examples.japanese: {大道具|おおどうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}み{立|た}てる→組み立てる：04661_kumitateru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{半日|はんにち}→半日：27978_hannichi⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took half a day to assemble the stage set.

examples.japanese: ⟦{舞台|ぶたい}{裏|うら}→舞台裏：08377_butaiura⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大道具|おおどうぐ}⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}{転換|てんかん}→場面転換：24731_bamentenkan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しく→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦{動|うご}いていた→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: Backstage, the set crew was busy moving things around for the scene change.

notes:
USAGE:
{大道具|おおどうぐ} refers to the large set pieces and scenery in theater and film. It also refers to the department or crew responsible for these items. Originally a kabuki theater term, now used broadly in all performing arts and film/TV production.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大道具|おおどうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧ (to build the stage set)
- {大道具|おおどうぐ}⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧ (set construction crew)
- {大道具|おおどうぐ}⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧ (person in charge of sets)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{小道具|こどうぐ}→小道具：12521_kodougu⟧ (small props, hand props) refers to portable items used by actors on stage, such as cups, swords, or letters. Together, {大道具|おおどうぐ} and ⟦{小道具|こどうぐ}→小道具：12521_kodougu⟧ cover all physical elements of a stage production.
